```python
def show_interview_framework():
    """Display interview framework"""
    print_header("🎯 INTERVIEW FRAMEWORK")
    
    print("""
Use RESO Framework:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

R - Requirements (5 minutes)
  ┌────────────────────────────┐
  │ □ Functional requirements  │
  │ □ Non-functional (scale)   │
  │ □ Constraints              │
  └────────────────────────────┘

E - Estimation (5 minutes)
  ┌────────────────────────────┐
  │ □ Calculate QPS            │
  │ □ Estimate storage         │
  │ □ Estimate bandwidth       │
  └────────────────────────────┘

S - System Design (20 minutes)
  ┌────────────────────────────┐
  │ □ High-level architecture  │
  │ □ Database schema          │
  │ □ API design               │
  │ □ Handle bottlenecks       │
  └────────────────────────────┘

O - Optimize (10 minutes)
  ┌────────────────────────────┐
  │ □ Discuss trade-offs       │
  │ □ Scaling strategies       │
  │ □ Monitoring & metrics     │
  │ □ Future improvements      │
  └────────────────────────────┘

SAMPLE QUESTIONS TO ASK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Functional:
  "What are the core features?"
  "Who are the users?"
  "Do we need real-time updates?"

Non-Functional:
  "How many daily active users?"
  "What's the expected QPS?"
  "What's the read/write ratio?"
  "Do we need high availability?"
    """)
```
